Blupi-App.title: Blupi
Blupi-App.description: Collaborative product design platform — service blueprints, live cursors, Chrome capture extension.
Blupi-App.command: (cd ~/.blupi-localdb && npx pglite-server -d ./data -p 5433 -m 10) & sleep 2; npx -y node@22 node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs --env-file-if-exists=.env server/index.ts
Blupi-App.notes: Node 22 + local PGlite DB on :5433. Dev sign-in button on the login page.
